title: Conformity Adventure
welcome_lead: Why do we go along with the crowd? 👥
meta_desc: Social Psychology Adventure 1 — KS3 Psychology on conformity and Asch's line study.
final_note: You learned what conformity is and how Asch showed it with simple lines.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Conformity is changing your view to match a group.

You might agree even when you think they're wrong — to fit in.

In 1951 Asch showed people three lines and asked which matched a target.

The answer was obvious. But fake group members chose wrong on purpose.

About 37% of trials, the real person also gave the wrong answer to fit in. 😳

Two reasons:

  • Normative — wanting to be liked.
  • Informational — thinking the group knows better.

Strong people can resist — that's independence. 💪
